name: Qube Browser 0.5.1
notes:
0.5.1
Fixed:
* Updates no longer fail right after you press Update

0.5.0
New:
* Notes: text notes and whiteboards, as tabs and in the Library
* Command bar with 60 commands, and Ask AI
* Qube Spark: chat with Claude or ChatGPT
* Streaming Space: a Space with a tile per streaming service
* Little Qube: links from other apps open in a small window
* Spotify as music source, next to Apple Music
* Per profile: search engine, download folder and extensions
* Full keyboard and Narrator support
* Settings in the Windows 11 style
* Works on PCs without a graphics card, such as Windows 365 Cloud PCs

Improved:
* Tabs not used for an hour are unloaded to save memory
* Windows from your last session reopen at start

Fixed:
* Permission questions and page dialogs no longer get lost
* A tab moved to another Space right after opening keeps its page
summary: Notes, a new command bar, a Streaming Space, and support for PCs without a graphics card.

mac.name: Qube for Mac 0.9.0
mac.notes:
New:

* Page menu: the button in the address bar opens Share, Capture, Capture Full Page, your extensions with a pin on each, and the site's settings (Developer Mode, Block Ads & Trackers, permissions you can switch between allowed and blocked)
* Capture: drag over part of a page, or take the full page; the picture goes to the clipboard, and a bubble at the top right offers Save and Share
* Developer Mode: on by itself for localhost, remembered per site; the tab gets a dashed outline and a toolbar with Copy Link, Capture, Console, Network, Inspect Element, extensions and Split View. View > Developer or Control-D switches it
* Pinned extensions sit in a grid in the sidebar, as on Windows

Changed:

* The address bar lights up as soon as the pointer is anywhere over the sidebar; no lock icon, and its buttons are drawn as Qube's own icons
* Menus in dark mode take the Space's colour and are darker; the shortcut on the chosen row stays readable, and every menu stays inside its window
* Settings use the normal macOS choice lists again; the Space form's profile list looks like Little Qube's
* Dragging tabs in the sidebar was rebuilt and follows the pointer as Essentials do
* Peek opens straight away on Option-click

Fixed:

* With Translucent or Liquid Glass, Qube no longer keeps the graphics chip busy when something moves
* Keys such as Control, Shift, Option and Command alone, key repeat and tooltips now reach pages
mac.summary: The page menu, Capture and Developer Mode, as Arc has them.
